## Acceptance

- the branch is based exactly on main commit 2659aed59a9fb9ac5a21d957f3eda85b54599d84 and contains only the declared Step 18 doctor/bootstrap packet files
- `doctor --profile bootstrap` validates repository, Python and venv support, Git, exact pinned Rust, Cargo, supported Node and exact pinned pnpm without requiring Docker
- `doctor --profile full` additionally validates Docker CLI, Compose v2 and a reachable Docker daemon
- doctor checks have deterministic order, machine-readable schema, human rendering and actionable remediation for every blocking failure
- bootstrap refuses failed prerequisites, creates an isolated `.venv`, uses committed constraints and lockfiles, and verifies locked Cargo metadata plus generated navigation
- bootstrap dry-run executes no command and reports the exact ordered shell-free argument plan

- permanent conformance executes focused lifecycle tests without adding a duplicate permanent workflow
- documentation does not claim `dev-up`, `dev-reset`, `seed-demo` or `smoke` are implemented and does not claim Step 18 or architecture 10/10 complete
- one unchanged meaningful head passes every applicable permanent workflow and final changed-file, comment, review and thread inspection
